items.title: Ernest Poree Interview, 1975-10-16
items.q: INTERVIEWER: You know who he was? Tom Anderson? ... INTERVIEWEE: Well, if that's... He was kind of Heverset, dude. I think he did. Big mustache.

ctx.x: No. I don't know why the club was named Arlington Club, but that's what the name of the club was.
Well, Tom Anderson used to have that club yesterday.
